shared_core_suggestions_only: Implement an Etsy OAuth callback and encrypted per-shop credential lifecycle in the existing connection framework.
Implement a signed webhook receiver using the existing durable EventInbox/EventDedup models; do not create an Etsy-only event bus.
Add per-key QPS/QPD headers, retry-after and cache telemetry to the existing adapter substrate.
